column3: n. 向上帝的供奉, 祭献, (对宗教、慈善业的)损献, 祭品
column5: The villagers placed grain and fruit on the altar as a solemn oblation.
column6: 村民们把谷物和水果摆上祭坛,作为庄严的祭品。

column3: a. 发呆的, 无精神的, 含糊的
column5: After the long flight he felt muzzy and could barely follow the conversation.
column6: 长途飞行后他头脑昏沉,几乎跟不上别人的谈话。

column3: n. 鱼网, 拘束, 束缚;vt. 拘束, 束缚
column5: The founder refused to let outside investors trammel his control of the studio.
column6: 创始人拒绝让外部投资者束缚自己对工作室的掌控。

column3: a. 反刍类的, 沉思的, 默想的;n. 反刍动物
column5: Cows and sheep are ruminant animals that digest tough grass in several stages.
column6: 牛和绵羊是反刍动物,会分几个阶段消化粗硬的牧草。

column3: v. 使绷紧, 拉紧
column5: The crew tautened the rigging before the storm arrived that evening.
column6: 暴风雨来临的傍晚,船员们提前绷紧了索具。

column3: v. 思考, 考虑
column5: The philosopher would cogitate for hours before answering even simple questions.
column6: 这位哲学家哪怕面对简单问题,也要思索数小时才作答。

column3: a. 结婚的, 夫妇的, 配偶的
column5: Their connubial bliss survived decades of hardship and frequent moves abroad.
column6: 他们婚姻的幸福经受住了多年艰辛和频繁的海外搬迁。

column3: v. 毁坏, 损坏, 玷污( mar的过去式和过去分词 )
column5: The otherwise flawless recital was marred by constant feedback from the microphones.
column6: 本属完美的独奏会被麦克风不断的杂音破坏了。

column3: a. 无疑的, 确实的, 明显的;不容置疑的, 明确的
column5: The fossil provided indubitable evidence that birds descended from small dinosaurs.
column6: 这块化石为鸟类源自小型恐龙提供了确凿证据。

column3: a. 陈腐的, 突降的
column5: The novel ends on a bathetic note, with the hero quietly selling shoes.
column6: 小说结尾虎头蛇尾,主人公默默改行去卖鞋了。

column3: a. 非假装的, 真实的, 诚实的
column5: She felt an unfeigned delight when her old friend finally won the prize.
column6: 老友最终获奖时,她由衷地感到高兴。

column3: n. 放弃, 舍弃, 克制
column5: Years of strict discipline taught the monk that abnegation brings a strange freedom.
column6: 多年的严修让僧侣体会到,自我克制带来一种奇异的自由。

column3: n. 小母鸡
column5: The farmer bought a young pullet at the market, hoping for eggs by spring.
column6: 农夫在集市上买下一只小母鸡,盼着开春能收蛋。

column3: n. 贫乏, 穷困的人们
column5: The charity provides monthly allowances to families living in deep indigence.
column6: 该慈善机构为深陷贫困的家庭每月发放补助金。

column3: vt. 使呈杂色;n. 杂色, 斑点
column5: Low sunlight mottled the plaster walls with soft patches of gold.
column6: 低斜的阳光在灰泥墙上洒下柔和的金色斑点。

column3: a. 净化的, 通便的, 赎罪的;n. 泻剂
column5: The old physician prescribed a mild purgative to cleanse the patient's system.
column6: 老医生开了一剂温和的泻药,为病人清理肠胃。

column3: a. 装聪明样的, 聪明的, 伶俐的, 有见识的
column5: The sapient judge weighed every argument carefully before delivering her final verdict.
column6: 睿智的法官仔细权衡每一项论点,然后才作出终审判决。

column3: a. 节约的, 节制的, 吝啬的, 爱惜的, 吝惜的, 节省的, 贫乏的, 少量的
column5: He is sparing with praise, so his compliments carry real weight here.
column6: 他极少夸人,因此他的称赞在这里很有分量。

column3: n. 力, 势, 权力
column5: The old poem celebrates the raw puissance of the ocean in winter.
column6: 这首古诗颂咏冬季大海原始而磅礴的力量。

column3: n. 扩张, 膨胀;膨胀, 扩张
column5: The doctor noted mild abdominal distention during the routine physical examination.
column6: 医生在常规体检中注意到患者腹部轻度膨胀。

column3: a. 无色的, 不分光的, 消色差的, 非染色质的;消色差的
column5: The achromatic lens removed the colored fringes from the telescope's image.
column6: 消色差透镜消除了望远镜图像边缘的彩色镶边。

column3: n. 小鹰
column5: An eaglet tested its wings on the cliff edge before its first long flight.
column6: 幼鹰先在崖边试着扑腾翅膀,再开始第一次长途飞行。

column3: n. 家具仓库, 家具搬运车
column5: A pantechnicon arrived at dawn to move the family's furniture to another city.
column6: 一辆家具搬运车清晨到达,要把这家的家具运往外地。

column3: n. 老人统治, 老人管理, 老人集团
column5: Critics argue the institute has become a gerontocracy that blocks younger researchers.
column6: 批评者认为该研究院已沦为压制年轻学者的老人政治。

column3: a. 稀少的, 细微的, 细小的
column5: The expedition survived on exiguous rations during the long polar winter.
column6: 探险队在漫长的极地冬季里靠微薄的口粮活了下来。

column3: a. 沉默寡言的, 阴沉的, 铅中毒的;铅的
column5: The saturnine guard rarely spoke and never once smiled at visitors.
column6: 那个阴沉的警卫很少说话,对来访者从未露出过笑容。

column3: vt. 巡行, 徘徊, 漫步于, 勘查;vi. 漫步, 闲荡, 迂回
column5: The inspector would perambulate the factory floor each morning, notebook in hand.
column6: 督察每天早晨都会拿着笔记本在车间里巡视一圈。

column3: a. 要咬人的, 厉声说话的, 没好气的
column5: The August heat made the old porter snappish with every passing customer.
column6: 八月的酷暑让年迈的搬运工对顾客动辄发火。

column3: n. 谜, 画谜

column6: 这份旧谜题版的每条谜面都是由小图画组成的画谜。

column3: a. 苗条的；线条清晰的；和蔼的

column6: 常年游泳让这位退休舞者年过七旬依然苗条。
